title: Console Suggestions: add analytics events for impressions, opens, and filter usage (privacy-safe)
author: Logan Wright
release_notes: Console: instrumented Suggestions beta with privacy-safe analytics for suggestion impression, open, and filter usage to support adoption + realized-savings measurement in ENG-2409.
commits: console/analytics: add event definitions + payload allowlist for Suggestions
console/suggestions: fire suggestion_impression on list render (debounced + viewability threshold)
console/suggestions: fire suggestion_opened on drawer open and include surface + position metadata
console/suggestions: fire suggestion_filter_applied for route/model/region filters
bff: add request_id propagation and tenant/workspace identifiers (hashed) for analytics correlation
tests: add unit coverage for payload redaction + schema validation
docs: update internal analytics catalog entry for Suggestions beta events
body: Summary: Adds Console analytics instrumentation for Suggestions beta to measure engagement and support realized-savings attribution work in ENG-2409. This PR introduces three events: suggestion_impression (list view), suggestion_opened (detail drawer), and suggestion_filter_applied (filters on list). Events are gated behind the existing suggestions_beta feature flag and are designed to be privacy-safe (no prompt content, no raw customer identifiers, no free-form strings). Motivation: We need reliable top-of-funnel signals (impressions/open rates) and behavior signals (filter usage) to (a) understand whether customers are discovering Suggestions, (b) identify friction in the UX, and (c) join engagement to downstream adoption + realized-savings measurement (implemented separately in the Optimize pipeline). Implementation details: Event names and semantics: (1) suggestion_impression — emitted when a suggestion row becomes viewable in the table viewport for >= 800ms, de-duped per page load. Emitted with list_context metadata and row position. (2) suggestion_opened — emitted when the detail drawer opens (row click or keyboard navigation). Includes the same suggestion key plus drawer entrypoint. (3) suggestion_filter_applied — emitted when a filter changes (route/model/region/risk/type). Includes only filter categories + cardinalities, not raw text. Privacy / payload safety: (a) tenant_id and workspace_id are SHA-256 hashed client-side using the existing analytics salt; we do not send raw IDs in analytics payloads. (b) suggestion_id is sent as the server-issued opaque ID (already not user PII); we also include suggestion_kind (batching|caching) and risk_level (low|medium|high). (c) route information: we do NOT send route path/name. Instead we include route_scope = {"single_route"|"all_routes"} and a stable route_hash when available (hash computed on the server from internal route UUID, not a human-readable string). (d) savings fields are bucketed to reduce leakage of precise spend: estimated_savings_usd_per_1m_tokens_bucket (e.g., 0-1, 1-5, 5-10, 10-25, 25-50, 50+) and monthly_estimated_savings_usd_bucket. (e) no prompt text, no request payloads, no model outputs, and no customer-provided tags are included. Basis-of-estimate fields shown in the UI are explicitly excluded. Debounce & volume controls: suggestion_impression is viewability-based and de-duped per suggestion per page session; filter events are debounced (250ms) and only fire on committed UI state changes (not on keystroke). Schema + validation: Introduces a strict allowlist-based schema for these events (packages/analytics-events/src/events/suggestions.ts). Both client and BFF enforce payload shape. Unit tests validate that unknown keys are dropped and that disallowed fields (e.g., route_name, prompt, freeform_text) never reach the tracking layer. Notes / follow-ups: (1) This PR does not implement adoption (apply) events since beta is read-only; adoption will come from config changes and control plane signals (tracked in follow-up to ENG-2409). (2) We intentionally do not log error strings from empty states; only a coarse reason_code (NO_SUGGESTIONS | INSUFFICIENT_TELEMETRY | FEATURE_FLAG_OFF | PERMISSION_DENIED). Testing: Manual: In staging with suggestions_beta enabled, open Console > Optimize > Suggestions. Verify in devtools network that analytics events are fired: suggestion_impression after scrolling list; suggestion_opened after clicking a row; suggestion_filter_applied after setting risk/type filters. Verify payload contains only hashed identifiers and bucketed savings. Automated: Added unit tests for schema/redaction and a lightweight e2e spec that asserts event emission counts and payload key set. Screenshots: N/A (no visible UI changes). Linked work: ENG-2409 (capture "suggestion viewed" and "suggestion adopted" events), ENG-2404 (Console Suggestions UI). Review focus: Please pay extra attention to privacy constraints and payload keys. Security reviewers: Naomi Feldman / Marcus Lin asked that we keep the payload allowlisted and avoid free-form strings; this PR does that and adds tests to prevent regression. Review conversation: Chloe Martin (requested changes): "Can we avoid sending anything that could be reverse-mapped to customer route names? Even hashed route names worry me if the input is low-entropy." Author (Logan Wright): "Agree. Updated to hash internal route UUID server-side (not route path/name) and added route_scope to avoid needing a route identifier for most events. Also bucketed savings fields." Mei Lin (comment): "Please include list_context fields so we can compute CTR by filter usage and paginate sessions." Author: "Added page_cursor_present, page_size, sort_order, and list_variant (table density) as enumerations." Naomi Feldman (comment): "Ensure workspace_id hashing uses the analytics salt and not a static hash." Author: "Confirmed we use existing analytics hashing util; added a unit test to ensure we call hashIdentifier() path. Also added explicit drop of workspace_id if missing salt." Nora Ahmed (approval): "Debounce looks good; +1 on viewability threshold vs immediate row render." CI: First run failed due to lint in docs/internal/analytics/suggestions-beta-events.md (markdown list formatting). Fixed and reran; all checks passing. Merge: Squash merged to main.
